pages.title: Further questions
pages.description: A few background questions about your everyday habits and attitudes.

items.prompt: How familiar are you with image editing or AI filters (e.g., Instagram filters, auto-enhance)?
In daily life, how easy is it for you to stay on top of schedules and everyday plans? (Higher = easier)
When you look at photographs, how closely do you usually attend to what is shown?
How much do you doubt information from official news or institutions?
